items.colloc: procure materials 採購材料 | procure supplies 取得供應品
items.distinct: purchase 購買（一般用語） | acquire 獲得（較正式）
ex: The department needs to procure new software.
該部門需要採購新軟體。
We plan to procure raw materials locally.
我們計畫在地採購原料。
They procured the necessary items for production.
他們取得了生產所需的項目。

items.colloc: approved vendor 核准供應商 | vendor list 供應商清單
items.distinct: supplier 供應商 | dealer 經銷商
ex: We must select a reliable office vendor.
我們必須選擇一家可靠的辦公用品供應商。
The vendor delivered the order on time.
供應商準時送達了訂單。
Please add this firm to the vendor list.
請將這家公司加入供應商清單。

items.pos: n. 採購申請書 | v. 徵用
items.colloc: submit a requisition 提交採購申請 | purchase requisition 採購單
items.distinct: application 申請 | request 要求
ex: Please submit your requisition by Friday afternoon.
請在週五下午前提交你的採購申請。
The manager signed the supply requisition form.
經理簽署了用品申請單。
All requisitions require formal approval from management.
所有申請都需要管理層正式核准。

items.colloc: request a quotation 要求報價 | obtain a quotation 取得報價
items.distinct: estimate 估價 | invoice 發票
ex: We received a competitive quotation from them.
我們收到了他們極具競爭力的報價單。
Please compare the quotations from three vendors.
請比較來自三家供應商的報價單。
The final quotation includes all shipping costs.
最終報價單包含了所有運費。

items.pos: adj. 大量的 | n. 容積；大量
items.colloc: bulk order 大量訂單 | buy in bulk 大量購買
items.distinct: mass 大眾的 | volume 總量
ex: We decided to buy office supplies in bulk.
我們決定大量購買辦公用品。
Bulk orders are eligible for a discount.
大量訂單有資格享有折扣。
The company saved money by purchasing in bulk.
公司透過大量採購節省了成本。

items.colloc: technical specifications 技術規格 | meet specifications 符合規格
items.distinct: description 描述 | criteria 標準
ex: The product failed to meet our specifications.
該產品未能達到我們的規格要求。
Please check the technical specifications for details.
請查閱技術規格以了解詳情。
These items strictly adhere to the project specifications.
這些項目嚴格遵守專案規格。

items.colloc: procurement department 採購部門 | procurement process 採購流程
items.distinct: purchase 購買行為 | acquisition 收購
ex: The procurement process takes about two weeks.
採購流程大約需要兩週時間。
She works in the corporate procurement office.
她在公司採購部門工作。
Better procurement policies can reduce operational costs.
更好的採購政策能降低營運成本。

items.colloc: independent contractor 獨立承包商 | general contractor 總承包商
items.distinct: employee 員工 | supplier 供應商
ex: The contractor finished the project ahead of schedule.
承包商提前完成了專案。
We hired an external contractor for the repairs.
我們雇用了一名外部承包商來進行維修。
Every contractor must sign the confidentiality agreement.
每位承包商都必須簽署保密協議。

items.pos: n. 折扣 | v. 打折
items.colloc: offer a discount 提供折扣 | volume discount 數量折扣
items.distinct: rebate 回扣 | deduction 扣除額
ex: They offered us a discount for early payment.
他們為提早付款提供我們折扣。
Can we get a discount on this bulk purchase?
這筆大量採購我們可以獲得折扣嗎？
The discount applies only to specific items.
折扣僅適用於特定品項。

items.colloc: outsource services 外包服務 | outsource production 外包生產
items.distinct: contract 訂約 | delegate 分派
ex: The company decided to outsource its marketing tasks.
公司決定將行銷工作外包。
They outsource all manufacturing to overseas firms.
他們將所有製造業務外包給海外公司。
Outsourcing helped us reduce labor costs significantly.
外包幫助我們顯著降低了勞工成本。

items.pos: v. 購買 | n. 購買；採購品
items.colloc: purchase order 採購單 | make a purchase 進行購買
items.distinct: procure 採購（正式） | shop 逛街
ex: We need to purchase new equipment this quarter.
我們這季需要購買新設備。
Please issue a purchase order for these items.
請針對這些品項開立採購單。
The purchase was authorized by the director.
這筆採購已獲得董事授權。

items.colloc: check availability 確認是否有貨 | stock availability 庫存狀況
items.distinct: access 使用權 | affordability 負擔能力
ex: Please check the availability of these spare parts.
請確認這些備用零件是否有貨。
The availability of the material is quite limited.
該材料的取得相當受限。
We will inform you about the product availability.
我們會通知您關於產品的庫存狀況。

items.pos: n. 可交付成果 | adj. 可遞送的
items.colloc: key deliverables 主要產出 | project deliverables 專案成果
items.distinct: product 產品 | outcome 結果
ex: The team defined the project deliverables clearly.
團隊清楚地定義了專案的可交付成果。
All deliverables must be submitted by Monday.
所有產出物必須在週一前提交。
He is responsible for the monthly deliverables.
他負責每個月的產出成果。

items.pos: v. 保證 | n. 保證；保固
items.colloc: money-back guarantee 退款保證 | provide a guarantee 提供保證
items.distinct: warranty 保固（書） | promise 承諾
ex: We guarantee that the goods will arrive tomorrow.
我們保證貨物明天會抵達。
The product comes with a two-year guarantee.
該產品附帶兩年保固。
They offer a full money-back guarantee policy.
他們提供完善的退款保證政策。

items.colloc: payment terms 付款條件 | contract terms 合約條款
items.distinct: conditions 狀況 | clauses 條款條項
ex: The payment terms are strictly thirty days net.
付款條件嚴格規定為三十天內付清。
I do not agree with the contract terms.
我不同意合約裡的條款。
They discussed the terms of the new agreement.
他們討論了新協議的條款。

items.pos: v. 超收費用 | n. 超收的費用
items.colloc: refund an overcharge 退還超收款 | avoid overcharge 避免超收
items.distinct: undercharge 少收 | surcharge 額外收費
ex: The company apologized for the accidental overcharge.
公司為意外超收費用表示歉意。
Check the bill to ensure they didn't overcharge.
檢查帳單以確保他們沒有多收費用。
The customer requested a refund for the overcharge.
顧客要求退還超收的款項。

items.colloc: batch of goods 一批貨物 | process in batches 分批處理
items.distinct: group 群組 | series 系列
ex: The first batch of products passed the inspection.
第一批產品通過了檢查。
We process the orders in daily batches.
我們每日分批處理這些訂單。
This new batch is of much better quality.
這批新產品的品質好多了。
